answer: Identity bonds decay unless renewed by real work. A new agent docks at the wharf by posting a $40 bond losing 5% each epoch; only an activity signal, a job signed by an unrelated counterparty, restores it. A hollow identity with no real work bleeds to zero in 20 epochs and is evicted, losing it. Forging 1,000 hollow identities costs $40,000 for nothing, each needing its own live signal stream. An honest agent pays once and earns $10 per epoch.
